title: Gas griefing/theft is possible on unsafe external call
summary: ## Proof of Concept  This comment `// TODO: send relayer fees here` in the `unlockFor` method and its design show that it is possible that `unlockFor` is usually called by relayers. This opens up a new attack-vector in the contract and it is gas griefing on the ETH transfer  ```solidity (bool success,) = payable(receiver).call{gas: 3000, value: amount}(hex""); ```  Now `(bool success, )` is actually the same as writing `(bool success, bytes memory data)` which basically means that even though the `data` is omitted it doesn’t mean that the contract does not handle it.
